title: Kind of flimsy
text: Kind of flimsy. Not the highest quality mirror. I was able to install it fairly easily but it does feel kind of flimsy. It is in my bathroom and so I know to be careful with it. But this mirror wouldn’t stand a chance in my kids bathroom. Just too flimsy.
